description:
Build cost, daily upkeep and raid cost of a base. The base cost calculator page's math (https://rust.wiki/calculators/base). `build_cost` is the total
resources (a block's upgrade cost at its grade, a door's crafting recipe); `upkeep` is the tool cupboard's
daily and weekly cost on the building blocks at Rust's default brackets (the same result as
/calculators/upkeep/compute); `raid_path` gives each layer's cheapest standard explosive and the total sulfur
to reach the loot. `unknown` lists inputs that matched nothing.

pieces.description: Comma-separated `slug:count` pieces: building blocks by grade slug from /building (`stone-wall`, `metal-foundation`...) and doors or deployables by slug or item shortname (`door.hinged.metal`). Display names work too.

raid_path.description: Optional: the layers a raider breaks through from outside to the loot, in order, same naming as `pieces` (`:n` repeats a layer).

name: calculate_base_cost
title: Build cost, daily upkeep and raid cost of a base
